site.name: Szawlowski Farm (potato farm), North Hatfield, Massachusetts, USA
site.description: one real working farm in the Connecticut River valley, documented by USDA NRCS over two flight days during the October 2019 potato harvest

planRaster.source: USGS The National Map — NAIP orthoimagery (public domain), via the USGSNAIPImagery ImageServer exportImage endpoint

exportParameters.bboxSR: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator — north-up, x-east-right by construction)

rasterToScene.derivation: Web Mercator box of 2400 m centered at (42.44, -72.6235); conformal scale factor 1/cos(lat) = 1.355042; true ground size 1771.2 m over 3000 px = 0.590388 m/px => 1.693803 px/m; the scene origin is declared at the raster center. THE HANDEDNESS LAW: the north-up/east-right convention is TRUE for this raster by construction (EPSG:3857 axis-aligned export), never assumed.

planRaster.fidelityNote: real public-domain orthoimagery of the same site — a plan RASTER with shared texture (not a line-art drawing; PORT.md §7's open gap)
planRaster.knownCaveat: the NAIP mosaic vintage at this location is NOT the same day, month or crop state as the October-2019 harvest photographs — the fields' vegetation state differs; this is recorded honestly and is part of what the evidence run measures
